title.narrative: JOINT PROGRAMME FOR THE SAHEL IN RESPONSE TO

description.narrative: The Joint Sahel Programme responds to the regional challenges of COVID-19, conflicts and climate change (‘3Cs’) and represents the first time the three UN Rome Based Agencies IFAD, FAO and WFP have jointed in partnership to implement a regional programme at scale. The programmes overarching objectives is the eradication of poverty and hunger in the most deprived rural areas in Senegal and the Sahel, using agriculture as the engine for achieving this goal. The aim is to consolidate the livelihoods of small-scale producers, particularly women and young people living in border regioins through the adoption of sustainable production practices and approaches to social cohesion and gender transformation. The program in Senegal will reach a total of, 18,000 agro-pastoral households for a total of around 180,000 people including 50 % adult women and 40 % young people of both sexes who will participate in initiatives to increase their resilience
